arc_morning.speaker: Frank
arc_morning.text: I'm under the car. If this isn't a pitch, come by when the bay is quieter.

arc_choice.speaker: Frank
arc_choice.text: You came back. Say what you came to say.

choices.text: Only if you want to talk. I'll listen.
Sunday could still be a place for you.

arc_heard.speaker: Frank
arc_heard.text: My wife was in the county hospital. He asked me to chair a work day that same week. I said I couldn't. The calls stopped. I stopped coming. I'm not asking you to fix it.

arc_pushed.speaker: Frank
arc_pushed.text: That's the pitch again. The bay is still mine. Come by for parts, not for Sunday.

arc_settled.speaker: Frank
arc_settled.text: You already heard it. Don't make a project out of it.

arc_pushed_later.speaker: Frank
arc_pushed_later.text: I said the bay isn't a pulpit.

closed.speaker: Frank
closed.text: Bay's open for parts. I'm in the middle of a brake job. The bridge is back up, if you're headed that way.

ask.speaker: Frank
ask.text: Margaret sent you for a screw, and I expect a sermon after it. The bay's open. The sermon can wait.

choices.text: What happened, if you want to say.
We could use you on Sunday.

listened.speaker: Frank
listened.text: Pastor Reece stopped returning calls. I'm not angry at the building. I'm tired of being useful and unheard.

pitched.speaker: Frank
pitched.text: Sunday's your work. This bay is mine. The screw's a number eight. It's on the bench.

later_listened.speaker: Frank
later_listened.text: You came back without a flyer. Don't make a project out of me.

later_invited.speaker: Frank
later_invited.text: If this is another Sunday pitch, I've got brake work. The screw's already on the bench.
